resources.string: Adds TomTom\'s real-time traffic to the time of car routes and picks the faster route when there is a jam. It needs your own free TomTom key.

What is sent to TomTom: the map squares (about 40 km wide) along each car route you plan, asked for with your key. Not your position, not the route itself, not what you search. TomTom\'s terms apply to your key and it has a free daily limit. Traffic data: TomTom.
A key is saved. It stays on this phone, encrypted, and is only sent to TomTom.
That does not look like a TomTom key. Paste it again, without extra text.
How to get a free key
Create a free account at developer.tomtom.com (no credit card), add an app with the Traffic API enabled and copy its key here. Your use counts against your own free quota.
